scope: UI consolidation only. The Target panel and mirrored selector are removed. Player, class powers and commands share one selector. Gameplay profiles and engine rules are unchanged.
migration: Both saved modes and imported v0.17 layouts retain the Powers location. Open state is merged; a lone legacy Target location is used as fallback. OBS and runtime preferences are preserved.

older Target layouts merge into the unified panel while preserving the Powers position and settings
random tests always choose the matching class for every power across a 128-player roster
a fixed player can test Kame then Thunder with visible class adaptation and canonical windup
disabling adaptation preserves an incompatible fixed class and explains the blocked power
missing classes can be adapted in random mode while falling players are never selected
a power pressed in the lobby starts combat and executes instead of silently failing
a fixed eliminated player stays selected and never redirects the action to a random survivor
training obeys pause, power restrictions, class restrictions and final-result lock
player commands and class selection affect the chosen player without creating a new sender
viewing targets and power availability never consumes combat randomness

each class has independent persisted preferences, configuration backup and restore without OBS changes
custom class priorities are identified beside historical measured win rates
eight languages name all five class preferences and all training controls

the unified test tool stays usable at phone width and opens directly in the mobile host
all five preference controls fit a phone and keep settings open while applying changes
